# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Olympic Movement
# Generated by COLDWAR_OLY_generator/build.py - do not edit by hand.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			# on_startup has no country scope: the scenario check runs on USA.
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_initialized }
					country_exists = USA
					USA = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
				}
				# Scripted effects need a country scope; the system itself only writes globals and tag scopes.
				USA = { cw_oly_initialize = yes }
			}
		}
	}

	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			# Savegame bootstrap: a 1970 game started before this system existed.
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_global_flag = cw_oly_initialized }
					IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
				}
				cw_oly_bootstrap = yes
			}
			# on_monthly pulses per country; the Olympic calendar runs once.
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = cw_oly_initialized
					# COLDWAR | hand patch 08.11.2026 (performance): day stamp gate instead of the timed global flag; the flag is still set for other readers.
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.cw_oly_monthly_done_next_day > global.num_days } }
				}
				set_global_flag = { flag = cw_oly_monthly_done days = 27 value = 1 }
				set_variable = { global.cw_oly_monthly_done_next_day = global.num_days }
				add_to_variable = { global.cw_oly_monthly_done_next_day = 27 }
				cw_oly_global_monthly = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
